summary: Phase 2 backend testing complete. Added /app/backend/tests/test_owm_phase2_audience.py with 22 focused tests covering: admin privacy config GET/PATCH (defaults singleton + persistence + audit log entry via /admin/audit), player audience ingestion + admin aggregate (samples_count / estimated_viewers / avg_attention / age_distribution / gender_distribution / by_hour), camera_enabled=false gate returns {ok:false}, admin mini-games CRUD (quiz+spin create, list, delete, /games/list active-only for both admin & advertiser), full QR game session flow (POST /games/session increments plays; POST /games/complete increments completions & marks status=completed; GET /games/session/{sid} returns session+game; invalid sid 404), screen mirror init->authorize->poll (text + image_url whitelisted; other content types rejected 400; unknown token 404; expires_in=300), engagement analytics (qr_scans, game_starts, game_completions, mirror_sessions, mirror_authorized, completion_rate), advertiser analytics (impressions/audience/attention/age/gender/game_starts/completions/per_campaign), CSV export for all 4 kinds (campaigns/devices/audience/engagement) with correct content-type + attachment header, PDF export with %PDF magic bytes, bad kind/fmt return 400, campaign rules PATCH ownership (owner 200, non-owner 404), player playlist AI scoring (targeting_score present with audience params; backward-compat items list returned without params), bulk driver CSV import (imports 2 rows, 1 failed row for missing email, non-csv 400). Regression: full pytest run of Phase 1 (21) + Phase 1.5 (14) + Phase 2 (22) = 57/57 passing.

minor.issue: Truly expired tokens cannot be tested end-to-end because expires_at is fixed at 5min from insert; no admin knob to force expiry. Guard logic is present (expired flag in response) but only verified for the not-yet-expired path in this suite.
Public endpoint (no auth) — anyone who guesses/leaks a token can push content to the player. Acceptable for the QR-based UX per spec, but consider rate-limiting or requiring device signature.
Both are public/unauthenticated. Session_id is a UUID so brute-forcing is hard, but there is no check that complete comes from the same device/user that started it — a race/replay is possible.
since = ISO string compared via $gte on stored ISO string; works because all writes use now_iso() (UTC, same format), but a device pushing localised timestamps would silently drop out of the window.

When the advertiser's campaigns have NO target_devices, the audience query falls back to `db.audience_samples.find()` across ALL devices → cross-tenant leakage of aggregated audience numbers into an advertiser's dashboard.
Row projection uses r.get('device_code') on audience_samples, which stores 'device_code' only when the sample was ingested via the device path — legacy or synthetic docs would render empty.
Default password 'Owm@12345' is hardcoded and shared across all imported drivers — HIGH-ish for prod, but acceptable for MVP CSV bootstrap. Recommend forcing password reset on first login.

action_items: Consider scoping /api/advertiser/analytics audience aggregation to devices the advertiser has actually run on — current fallback returns global audience when target_devices is empty.
Add per-device or per-user auth to /api/games/complete to prevent replay/spoofing of completion counts.
Force password reset on first login for drivers imported via /api/admin/drivers/bulk (currently all share the default 'Owm@12345').
Consider adding a device-signature or short-lived HMAC to /api/mirror/authorize; token in URL/QR is enough for MVP but should not be the only barrier.
server.py is now 1475 lines — split into routers (auth, drivers, devices, ads/campaigns, player, admin, phase2).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1475 lines (was 1031 in iter_2) — routers/modularisation is now urgent, phase-2 alone added 400 lines.
CORS still allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True — invalid for cookie-based browser auth; bearer flow works so tests pass, but SPA cookie login will silently fail in strict browsers.
Cross-tenant leak in /advertiser/analytics: when campaigns[].target_devices is empty, the audience aggregate becomes global — the advertiser sees other advertisers' audience mixed in.
/games/session and /games/complete are unauthenticated — no session-owner check makes completion counts spoofable.

Reports export kind=audience projects 'device_code' but audience_samples aggregate view uses stored 'device_code' only when set by the ingest path — legacy docs will show blank cells; consider left-join / fallback via device_id lookup.
Bulk driver import defaults password to 'Owm@12345' with no forced reset — anyone reading source can log in as an imported driver.
Mirror authorize accepts content only for {'text','image_url'} but does not sanitise or validate the image_url (SSRF/beacon risk if player renders without CSP).
audience $gte on ISO strings: works because all writers use datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() but is fragile across timezone-format changes; prefer a real datetime field and $gte on datetime.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@onwheelsmedia.com / Admin@12345. Test users/drivers/devices created with TEST_ / test_bulk_ prefixes inside each test.

rca of the issue: Only tester-side issue: initial run used /api/admin/audit-logs while server exposes /api/admin/audit → 404. Fixed by correcting the URL. No server-side bug.
